android.extraProguardRules:
# OkHttp (via React Native networking) references optional TLS providers that are
# never on the runtime classpath. AGP 8 escalates the missing-class warning to a
# build failure, so they are silenced explicitly rather than left to chance.
-dontwarn org.conscrypt.**
-dontwarn org.bouncycastle.**
-dontwarn org.openjsse.**

# Hermes + Expo module registries resolve these through JNI/reflection, so R8
# cannot see the call sites and would otherwise strip them.
-keepclasseswithmembernames class * { native <methods>; }

extra._comment_api: Production Laravel API on its own subdomain (Cloudflare-proxied). Confirmed live and reachable — POST /auth/login, GET /products, GET /refills and GET /badges were all verified against this host to return exactly the shapes src/lib/mappers.ts expects, and all 5 UserSeeder.php accounts (one per role) were confirmed to authenticate. For local development against Laragon use http://10.0.2.2:8000/api/v1 (Android emulator) or http://<LAN-IP>:8000/api/v1 (physical device), then rebuild.
extra._comment_pusher: Pusher Channels app 2191062, cluster ap1. Replaced self-hosted Reverb because this shared hosting cannot expose a persistent WebSocket process behind a reverse proxy (confirmed: a raw WS upgrade to the API domain returned Laravel's own 404 page, meaning nothing proxies it to Reverb at all, and the raw Reverb port timed out — the host firewall drops it). Only the public app KEY + CLUSTER go here; the App Secret stays backend-only, in the Laravel .env (PUSHER_APP_SECRET), and must never appear in this file or in the mobile bundle. useRealtime() falls back to a 10s poll and shows an honest 'Mode luring' banner whenever these are blank or the socket can't connect — see that file's docblock. Switching broadcaster does not by itself fix delivery: PublishOutboxEvent is a QUEUED job (QUEUE_CONNECTION=database in the backend), and nothing currently processes that queue — see soul_coffe.backend's queue-worker cron note. Until that cron exists, events never reach Pusher OR Reverb; the gap isn't which broadcaster is configured.
extra._comment_demoMode: false: every screen now calls the real Laravel API at apiBaseUrl instead of src/features/demo/router.ts's in-memory fixtures. DemoBanner and the role-switcher (loginAsDemoRole) are gone from the UI — real accounts must exist in the backend's users table with is_active=1. Flip back to true only for an offline standalone demo build; see README's "Real backend" section for the wire-format gaps that src/lib/mappers.ts papers over.
